title: Return Ceremony
hero_prompt: A copperplate engraving: a woman at a stone threshold gate unrolls a hand-inked map of nameless coastlines and paths toward a traveller stepping out of low fog, the map's lines taut and certain against the traveller's soft outline. Hand-made copperplate engraving, antique cartographic style, with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
icon_prompt: Flat black silhouette icon on a plain white ground, one bold shape, no shading, no gradients, no gloss: A bold copperplate-engraved compass rose with one thick arrow pointing straight through an open gate, stark black lines on ivory.
